title: Glueing data for sheaves of abelian groups, algebraic structures or modules produces a sheaf in the relevant category
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: 17 行、粘合数据在结构范畴中的实现：截段是集合层等化子；三个范畴中等化子带典范结构且 phi_ij 是范畴内态射，故底层集合等化子自动是范畴对象，构造落在目标范畴内。承重两步（等化子描述、结构提升）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-glue-sheaves-structures (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5469-5480

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the set-level construction computes sections as an equalizer of products, and in each of the three categories this equalizer carries a canonical structure making it an object of the category, so the glued presheaf is a sheaf with values there (source lines 5482-5498)
